name: Snip Snap Snorem
summary: An 18th-century shedding game where players must complete four-of-a-kind sets in rank order to be first to empty their hand.
rules_text: All 52 cards are dealt one by one clockwise; players with fewer cards ante an extra chip. Each player antes one chip. The player left of dealer starts a series by playing any card face up. The current series is defined by that rank: the next three plays must be the other three cards of that same rank, in any suit order, if held. Turns go clockwise; you must play the needed rank if you have it, otherwise you pass and ante one chip. After the fourth card of a rank is played, that series ends and the player who played it starts a new series with any card from hand. First player to play all their cards wins the pot.
rating_reason: Matching shedding game, turn-based hidden hands, sequential choice.
